title: Restore and refine the size dropdown
summary: Restore the original expandable size selector with a quieter, more compact visual treatment.

changes.detail: Removed the inline size buttons and redundant panel heading, availability counter and repeated Selected wording.

Restored the dropdown trigger, scrollable options, selection close, quantity reset, size guide, Escape/Android-back dismissal, web focus return and panel visibility scrolling. Use matching 10px corners, aligned text, a subtle selected row and simple checkmark.
